Brazil: who can obtain a digital nomad visa VITEM XI in 2026

VisaHQ has published a detailed analysis of the rules for the Brazilian digital nomad visa (VITEM XI) for the year 2026.

Main requirements:
- Income from abroad of at least $1,500 per month or savings of $18,000
- Contract with a foreign employer or clients
- Certificate of no criminal record for the last 5 years
- Health insurance valid in Brazil

Important: If you receive a salary from a Brazilian company, you need to apply for a regular work visa (VITEM V).

How to apply:
- At a Brazilian consulate abroad
- Or through the MigranteWeb portal (if you are already in the country)

Processing time is up to 120 days. The fee in 2026 is R$ 204.77.

Brazil remains one of the most accessible options among G20 countries in terms of minimum income requirements. The program is particularly convenient for companies launching "work-from-anywhere" pilots.
